sections.heading: Unexpected sign of investor interest
sections.content: Zhao said dog treats arrived at the office, whose address wasn’t public. He connected the gift to a post on Twitter about the office dog and said someone had tracked down the address and followed them on Twitter. The unexpected delivery made him pause and realize there was enough investor interest.
